articles.title: Liveblog:Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Ukrainer protestieren gegen Entlassung des Verteidigungsministers
articles.teaser: Demonstranten in der Ukraine fordern, Verteidigungsminister Mychajlo Fedorow zurück ins Amt zu holen. Lambsdorff sieht bei Putin keinen Verhandlungswillen. Das Liveblog
articles.image_title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Rally Over Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov's Resignation DNIPRO, UKRAINE - JULY 16: Protesters hold posters during a rally against the dismissal of Mykhailo Fedorov in Dnipro on July 16, 2026 in Dnipro, Ukraine. On July 12, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced plans for a government reshuffle, and on July 15 Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov confirmed his resignation. Fedorov's departure sparked protests, with demonstrators calling on President Zelenskyy to keep him in office. Similar rallies were held in other cities across Ukraine. (Photo by Denys Poliakov/Global Images Ukraine via Getty Images)
